notes.title: IT'S HERE! See Ya Later! 2.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Thank you so much for waiting! The new version of SYL! is finally here! I originally thought this would be a 5 month project but like everything else in life it took a lot longer. I hope this is a better experience for everyone and I hope you enjoy it even more than "Classic" SYL!.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43169143/97453d7950803b512b8ae12e5d9b084f6168f0ed.png

Just a quick list of a few new additions:

 Achievements
 Lifeoid and Objectoid tracker
 New Enemies
 NPCs can now be eaten
 Torches
 Broken Parts Mode
Swimming
 Wetness
 Body Temperature
 Controller Support


Future Improvements/Additions

 Bringing back clothing
 Additional biomes/worlds
 Different weather effects
 Fishing tuning and updates


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43169143/97453d7950803b512b8ae12e5d9b084f6168f0ed.png

This is still in early access, so if you experience any bugs please let me know! Be on the look out for future updates as well.

As for the Classic version I will be re-releasing that first on Itch.io in the next few weeks and then later on here.

Thanks again to all those who have been supporting this project, I really do appreciate it. <3

See Ya Later - 
Mike Krow

notes.title: Gone Fishing... well... kinda..
notes.content:
Here we are again, another update! 

This month past and I worked on a bunch of stuff, so its time for a little updatey in the form of a bulleted list, as is the custom.


 craft book
 farming
 wetness
 bottles
 clothing
 gun
 bug catcher
 game finished screen
 scene pieces like houses and shops
 parts tracker



I tackled two of the biggest hurdles this month in creating the craft book and farming aspects of the game. Most of the other stuff didnt take too long.

notes.title: Another Month of Progress!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Another month passed and hopefully with minimal reckless space ship flying. I've been hard at work rebuilding See Ya Later! in the Godot Engine. It's been a learning curve for sure but I think I've made some good progress.


I've been able to get quite a bit running I think. Some of that stuff being:

 Crafting
 Day Night Cycle
 Poisoning
 Mining
 Fire!!!!!!
 NPCs, Items
 Containers, Vendors
 Menu system


*Some Underground Mining*
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43169143/e909a48f165d94ef3a5f655e5254fde86e30c0af.png



*Enjoying a Day by the Water*
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43169143/066d1af4f9ef5234bd87e60b5063bf1b0db209f6.gif


*Chopping Trees*
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43169143/bd4a2731d51cb0aba5fb74ab8ebd1917388b5125.png

*Menu*
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43169143/ff03b540a64b60782875c25378f6832a2b7c7bcd.png


Still a lot to go just to get it back up to speed of the original and I'll keep you updated! Thanks for being there. 

See Ya Later!
-Mike
